title: Spending Proposal: Terra Classic Upgrade to Cosmos SDK v0.53 with IBC v2 (Eureka) Support - Phase 1
summary: Spend Proposal for Phase 1 of the Terra Classic upgrade to Cosmos SDK v0.53 with IBC v2 (Eureka) support.
details: This proposal requests funding for Phase 1 (Testnet Implementation & Validation) of the Terra Classic upgrade to Cosmos SDK v0.53 with IBC v2 (Eureka) support. Phase 1 includes: Core upgrade execution (SDK v0.53.4, CometBFT v0.38.19, Wasmd v0.61.4, IBC-Go v10.3.0), rebel-2 testnet deployment, IBC v2 multi-hop routing tests, failure scenario validation, and publication of results and developer guidance. The proposal requests funding of $40,000 USD (equivalent to approximately 1,045,997,684 LUNC at current price of $0.00003825 per LUNC) for the work.
vote_option_context: Yes: You support funding Phase 1 of the SDK v0.53 + IBC v2 upgrade and want to approve the spending proposal. No: You do not support this spending proposal. No With Veto: You believe this spending proposal is harmful to the network. Abstain: You have no opinion and want to abstain from voting.
